ios.desc:
Want to keep grandma's best recipes handy? Hate scrolling through recipe site ads? Scan handwritten cards, save websites, and organize everything into one clutter-free collection.

"Freaking perfect! This app speaks directly to me as someone who cooks daily." - 5-star review
"Pinterest replacement! After porting all my recipes, I haven't looked back." - ClipDish user

Save, Organize, and Cook with Ease

Save Any Recipe in Seconds

• Enhanced OCR scanning captures multi-page cookbooks, magazines, and handwritten recipes perfectly
• Extract clean recipes from any website—skip the life stories
• Apple Intelligence automatically categorizes recipes (iPhone 15 Pro+)
• AI Chef assistant answers cooking questions and suggests substitutions

Organize Your Kitchen Life

• Revolutionary Cooking Mode—navigate multiple recipes seamlessly while cooking
• Create custom collections for meal prep, holidays, or date nights
• Professional PDF export creates beautiful recipe cards for sharing
• Search recipes by ingredients, cuisine, or your custom tags
• Integrates with Apple Reminders for creating grocery lists

show_hn.title: Show HN: ChatGPT Powered Sous Chef

quotes.text:
Hi everyone,

I love seeing all of the projects coming out built with the ChatGPT APIs. I figured it was time to share mine.

I recently added ChatGPT to our iOS cooking app ClipDish. It's like having a cooking instructor right with you in the kitchen.

I'm still experimenting with it and I'm interested in seeing how people use it. Some of the things that I think it works great for.

Describing cooking techniques.

Converting between units of measurements

Ingredient substitutions (which is great when you're grocery shopping and can't find a specific ingredient)

cocktail recipes

It can provide recipes too but I'm trying to figure out a better UI for displaying longer content.

There is basic Siri integration too but that still needs some refinement.
